description: This file defines a base class for media playback tests involving GStreamer elements, including setup and callback handling for video and audio elements, and various test scenarios for media tasks.

classes.name: TasksTestsBase
classes.description: A base class providing common setup, expectations, and trigger methods for media playback tests involving GStreamer elements.

methods.name: expectSetupVideoElement
methods.description: Sets expectations for setting up a video element, including factory checks and signal connections.

methods.name: expectSetupAudioElement
methods.description: Sets expectations for setting up an audio element, including factory checks and signal connections.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementOnly
methods.description: Prepares expectations for setting up a video element without specific sink types.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementWesterossink
methods.description: Prepares expectations for setting up a Westerossink video element.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementAmlhalasink
methods.description: Prepares expectations for setting up an Amlhalasink video element.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementPendingGeometryNonWesterissink
methods.description: Prepares expectations for setting up a video element with pending geometry, not using Westerossink.

methods.name: shouldSetupAudioElementOnly
methods.description: Prepares expectations for setting up only an audio element.

methods.name: shouldSetVideoUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Prepares to verify setting of the video underflow callback.

methods.name: triggerVideoUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Simulates triggering the video underflow callback.

methods.name: shouldSetAudioUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Prepares to verify setting of the audio underflow callback.

methods.name: triggerAudioUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Simulates triggering the audio underflow callback.

methods.name: triggerSetupElement
methods.description: Executes the setup element task.

methods.name: setPipelineToNull
methods.description: Sets the pipeline in the test context to null.

methods.name: triggerSetVideoGeometryFailure
methods.description: Executes a SetVideoGeometry task expected to fail and verify pending geometry remains unchanged.

methods.name: shouldSetVideoGeometry
methods.description: Prepares expectation for setting the video rectangle.

methods.name: triggerSetVideoGeometrySuccess
methods.description: Executes a SetVideoGeometry task expected to succeed and update pending geometry.

methods.name: setAllSourcesAttached
methods.description: Marks all sources as attached in the test context.

methods.name: shouldScheduleAllSourcesAttached
methods.description: Prepares expectation for scheduling all sources attached.

methods.name: triggerSetupSource
methods.description: Executes the setup source task.

methods.name: shouldSetGstVolume
methods.description: Prepares expectation for setting the GStreamer stream volume.

methods.name: triggerSetVolume
methods.description: Executes the set volume task.
